content:
Liam Gomez: hi team, day 1 and i'm stuck. trying to open the Redwood Console (staging) to check feature flags but every link redirects to the SSO page and then a 404. MFA didn't fire. who do i bug for a quick staging access lift?
Priya Nair: welcome Liam!! :wave: ping Casey (IT Ops) here — they handle short-lived console roles. also try clearing cookies or using an incognito window, sometimes okta session is funky.
Liam Gomez: tried incognito and another browser, same 404 after okta. no MFA prompt.
Casey (IT Ops): hey @Liam Gomez, sorry for the friction. that 404 after SSO usually means your SSO profile hasn't synced to the staging-roles group. can you run a quick check: sign into okta.cloud.redwood.ai and confirm you see the "Redwood Apps" tile? if not, i'll kick a sync.
Liam Gomez: i can sign into okta and see Redwood Apps. i clicked Console (staging) tile and it threw the same 404.
DevBot: Heads-up: there's a transient sync issue between Okta -> staging-directory service from 2026-02-12 09:12 UTC affecting new users. Status: investigating.
Priya Nair: fyi Jordan (manager) is copied on the welcome email — Jordan Rivers can approve a JIT if needed.
Casey (IT Ops): @Jordan Rivers can you approve a short staging role for Liam? request: role=staging:console-viewer, duration=45m. I'll follow up with a full sync so Liam gets permanent mapping.
Jordan Rivers: approved. go ahead Casey.
Casey (IT Ops): done — created request RQ-7782 and applied a one-time session. Liam, try now.
Liam Gomez: i can load the Console nav now! thanks team. i can see the Flags tab but not the Owners section (greyed out).
Casey (IT Ops): that's expected for viewer. if you need to toggle flags for a quick smoke test, ask for `staging:flag-tester` for a scoped 30m window and include the flag name. otherwise file an access ticket and we'll map the group properly.
Liam Gomez: could i get flag-tester for `experiment/rewrite-path` for 30 mins? will do a quick toggle then revert.
Casey (IT Ops): granted (RQ-7783). session lives for 30m. dev tip: audit logs capture the exact toggle and user; don't forget to revert.
DevBot: Access grant RQ-7783 recorded. Audit token: AT-44321.
Liam Gomez: toggled and ran a local smoke test. behavior looks good. reverted the flag. all set :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone for the speedy help!
Priya Nair: awesome — if anything else blocks you today, drop in #new-hires or ping me. also we've got a short "console basics" 1:1 at 3pm if you want to join.
Casey (IT Ops): follow-up: i've queued a full SSO->staging directory resync for later today to prevent more 404s for new hires. will post in #eng-infra when complete.
